column8: List.map Prod.fst (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanoutConnected Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched fun x => Bool.true) = [0, 1, 2] ∧ List.map Prod.fst (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanoutConnected Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched fun ρ => ρ != 0) = [1, 2]

(Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanout Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched fun x => Bool.true) = [(0, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.live), (1, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.live), (2, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.live)] ∧ (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanout Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched fun ρ => ρ != 0) = [(0, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.mailbox), (1, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.live), (2, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Route.live)]

List.countP (fun x => x.2 == Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.holder 11) (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched.assembleTagged Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.prf 1 3 Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.received) = 1 ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.sched.leasedSlots 1 11 = 1 ∧ (List.filter (fun x => x.1 == 11) Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Example.received).length = 2

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) (ρ : ℕ), (sched.assembleAt prf e t received ρ).1.header = sched.headerAt e t ρ

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) {prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf} {e t : ℕ} {received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)} {ρ : ℕ} {s : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.SubjectId}, (sched.assembleAt prf e t received ρ).2 = Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.holder s → sched.holderOf e ρ = Option.some s ∧ (s, (sched.assembleAt prf e t received ρ).1) ∈ received

(sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) → Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf → ℕ → ℕ → List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile) → List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Cell sched.profile × Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source)

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)), (sched.assemble prf e t received).length = sched.n
∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) {e t ρ : ℕ}, ρ < sched.n → ↑(sched.headerAt e t ρ).slot = ρ

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) {c : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Cell sched.profile}, c ∈ sched.assemble prf e t received → ∃ ρ < sched.n, c.header = sched.headerAt e t ρ

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) {ρ : ℕ} {s : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.SubjectId} {c : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Cell sched.profile}, ρ < sched.n → sched.holderOf e ρ = Option.some s → c.header = sched.headerAt e t ρ → (s, c) ∈ received → (∀ sub ∈ received, sched.accepts e t ρ sub = Bool.true → sub = (s, c)) → sched.assembleAt prf e t received ρ = (c, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.holder s) ∧ c ∈ sched.assemble prf e t received
∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) {ρ : ℕ}, ρ ∈ sched.slots ↔ ρ < sched.n
Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16 → Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Profile → (n : ℕ) → List Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Lease → n ≤ 65536 → Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) (c : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Cell sched.profile), sched.leaseAt e ↑c.header.slot = Option.none → c ≠ Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fillCell sched.profile prf c.header → c ∉ sched.assemble prf e t received

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) {ρ : ℕ} {s : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.SubjectId}, sched.holderOf e ρ ≠ Option.some s → (sched.assembleAt prf e t received ρ).2 ≠ Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.holder s

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) (s : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.SubjectId), List.countP (fun c => sched.holderOf e ↑c.header.slot == Option.some s) (sched.assemble prf e t received) = sched.leasedSlots e s

∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (e t : ℕ) (received : List (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Submission sched.profile)) (s : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.SubjectId), List.countP (fun x => x.2 == Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.holder s) (sched.assembleTagged prf e t received) ≤ sched.leasedSlots e s
{motive : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Source.fill → motive t

∀ {pid : UInt8} {P : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Profile}, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.profileOfId pid = Option.some P → ∀ {domain n epoch tick : ℕ} {leaseBytes receivedBytes pad : List UInt8}, n ≤ 65536 → (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.records 28 leaseBytes).isSome = Bool.true → (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.records (8 + P.C) receivedBytes).isSome = Bool.true → (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.assembleBytesList pid domain n epoch tick leaseBytes receivedBytes pad).length = n * (P.C + 1)

∀ {pid : UInt8} {P : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Profile}, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.profileOfId pid = Option.some P → ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≤ 65536 → ∀ (presence : List UInt8), (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanoutBytesList pid n presence).length = 5 * n
∀ (sched : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Schedule) (p : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Presence), List.map Prod.fst (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fanout sched p) = sched.slots

∀ (P : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Profile) (prf : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.FillPrf) (h : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Header), (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fillCell P prf h).encode.length = P.C ∧ (Minidregg.Theory.Channel.fillCell P prf h).header = h
∀ {α : Type} (l : List α) (c : ℕ), (List.map (fun x => c) l).sum = l.length * c
